body.statement: Under the Gaussian calibration and marginal sampling conditions, whenever \(\eta_{S,n}<1\) and every \(\eta_{a,n}<1\), the explicit radii in \(\mathcal C_n(\alpha)\) satisfy \(\Pr\{\mathcal O_S\in\mathcal C_n(\alpha)\}\ge1-\alpha\), and on this event \(\Theta_S(\mathcal O_S)\subseteq\widehat\Theta_{S,n}(\alpha)\). More explicitly, for any positive-definite \(\mathcal O'_S\) with \(u=d_{\mathrm{obs}}(\mathcal O_S,\mathcal O'_S)\le\min\{\lambda_*/2,L_B^{-1}\}\), every order and observed view pair obey \(\|B_\pi^{(a)}(\mathcal O'_S)-B_\pi^{(a)}(\mathcal O_S)\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le L_Bu\) and \(\|R_\pi^{ab}(\mathcal O'_S)-R_\pi^{ab}(\mathcal O_S)\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le\omega_{\mathrm{feas}}(u)=L_Ru\); every corresponding directed-path product changes by at most \(\omega_{\mathrm{path}}(u)=L_{\mathrm{path}}L_Bu\). Hence, if \(\omega_{\mathrm{feas}}(u)\le\kappa_{\mathrm{feas}}/2\), then \(\Pi_S(\mathcal O'_S)\subseteq\Pi_S(\mathcal O_S)\). On the coverage event, if \(2\bar r_n(\alpha)\le\min\{\lambda_*/2,L_B^{-1}\}\), \(\omega_{\mathrm{feas}}(2\bar r_n(\alpha))\le\kappa_{\mathrm{feas}}/2\), and \(\omega_{\mathrm{path}}(2\bar r_n(\alpha))\le\kappa_{\mathrm{path}}/2\), then the Hausdorff distance induced by \(d_{\mathrm{coef}}\) from \(\widehat\Theta_{S,n}(\alpha)\) to \(\Theta_S(\mathcal O_S)\) is at most \(2L_B\bar r_n(\alpha)\), and \(\widehat\prec_{S,n}(\alpha)=\prec_S\). Consequently, if \(\min(n_S,\min_{a\in M}n_a)\to\infty\), the two novel margins are bounded below by \(\kappa_{\mathrm{feas}}>0\) and \(\kappa_{\mathrm{path}}>0\), and \(\alpha_n\to0\) with vanishing radii, then Hausdorff consistency and exact essential-poset recovery hold in probability.
body.justification: Set inversion makes uncertainty honest when the population output is non-singleton, while the explicit moduli translate covariance error into branch and ancestral-path stability.
body.gap: ChernozhukovHongTamer2007SetInference gives general contour inversion, while GhoshalHonorio2018LinearSEM uses precision-diagonal and nonzero-precision-entry gaps for one recursive graph. Neither source defines the wrong-order residual or common-ancestral path-product margins, nor derives the displayed LiMVAM covariance-to-margin moduli.
body.consumer: A future Cam-CAN MEG or fMRI diagnostic analysis can report an uncertainty-aware sensitivity envelope only after checking common-target sampling and failing to reject the component-aligned repeated-sensor mechanism on observed calibration blocks.
